shots.text: Prism Wastes is the glass plain in front of Solenne. Cassivane's whole army came across it, and we fell back to the walls.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Glass plains under a black sky, shattered into six colours. The army of the Concord falling back toward the city walls.

shots.text: That night the Lumen Gate fell, the outer wall of Solenne. It was the only wall we lost in the whole war.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The outermost wall collapsing in dust.

shots.text: Behind it, Seraphel drew her sword. She was the last knight of the Sunstone, and its light had kept her alive for a thousand years. Since it broke, she had been dying.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Through the dust: Seraphel, tall, in white-gold plate with six dimming colours, drawing a greatsword of Sunstone glass that glows like dawn.

shots.text: I have a few days left. Let me spend them on your wall.
shots.speaker: seraphel
shots.art_note: Seraphel on the second wall beside the Queen, sword planted. Joins as a hero.
